comp-lmc.title: Multi-band composite
comp-lmc.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.

comp-lmc-field.title: Composite with the Planck field
comp-lmc-field.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.
comp-lmc-field.smoothing: Field texture: Q and U smoothed with a 10′ sigma Gaussian (FWHM 24′ with the Planck beam), then drawn as line integral convolution.

fits.what: Field position angle, east of north (deg)
Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

comp-galactic_centre.title: Multi-band composite
comp-galactic_centre.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.

comp-galactic_centre-field.title: Composite with the Planck field
comp-galactic_centre-field.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.
comp-galactic_centre-field.smoothing: Field texture: Q and U smoothed with a 10′ sigma Gaussian (FWHM 24′ with the Planck beam), then drawn as line integral convolution.

comp-monoceros_ob1.title: Multi-band composite
comp-monoceros_ob1.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.

comp-monoceros_ob1-field.title: Composite with the Planck field
comp-monoceros_ob1-field.stretch: Per band: background removal, asinh stretch from a percentile black point, starlet sharpening, colour screen blend.
comp-monoceros_ob1-field.smoothing: Field texture: Q and U smoothed with a 10′ sigma Gaussian (FWHM 24′ with the Planck beam), then drawn as line integral convolution.

comp-lmc-ridges.title: Ridge filter, Herschel 250 µm
comp-lmc-ridges.stretch: Strongest negative Hessian eigenvalue of log intensity at sigma 1.5, 3 and 6 pixels (scale-normalised), normalised to the 99.5th percentile.

lmc-dust.title: Planck 353 GHz intensity
lmc-dust.stretch: asinh (softening 0.2) between the 2nd and 99.8th percentile (0.745 to 16.413 mK_CMB), copper palette.
lmc-dust.smoothing: Unsmoothed; the solar dipole is fitted away from the plane and removed.

bar.label: I 353
bar.note: zero level not calibrated; asinh colour scale

lmc-bfield.title: Planck dust with the field texture
lmc-bfield.stretch: Dust stretch as the intensity image; the line integral convolution texture is added to the value before the colour map (amount 0.4).
lmc-bfield.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 12 pixel (8′) Gaussian, FWHM 20′ with the beam. Angle drawn in grid coordinates (render_lmc.grid_angle).

fits.what: Field position angle, east of north (deg)
Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

lmc-bfield-v.title: Planck dust with the field texture
lmc-bfield-v.stretch: Dust stretch as the intensity image; the line integral convolution texture is added to the value before the colour map (amount 0.4).
lmc-bfield-v.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 12 pixel (8′) Gaussian, FWHM 20′ with the beam. Angle drawn in grid coordinates (render_lmc.grid_angle).

fits.what: Field position angle, east of north (deg)
Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

lmc-lic.title: Field texture only
lmc-lic.stretch: Line integral convolution of white noise along the field direction, min-max normalised.
lmc-lic.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 12 pixel (8′) Gaussian, FWHM 20′ with the beam.

fits.what: Field position angle, east of north (deg)
Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

lmc-hi.title: H I column density
lmc-hi.stretch: Moment 0 over 182 to 339 km/s (LSR), asinh (softening 0.15) between the 2nd and 99.9th percentile (0 to 2753 K km/s), grey palette. Column density assumes optically thin gas, 1.823e+18 cm⁻² per K km/s.

bar.label: N(H I)
bar.note: 0 to 2753 K km/s, optically thin; asinh colour scale

lmc-vel.title: H I mean velocity
lmc-vel.stretch: Intensity-weighted mean velocity from 200 (blue) to 320 km/s (red), RdBu_r; brightness is the H I column to the power 0.8. Pixels below the 35th percentile of the column are set to the median velocity.

bar.label: v
bar.note: brightness follows the H I column

lmc-co.title: CO(1-0) clouds
lmc-co.stretch: Moment 0 of channels above 3 sigma (MAGMA rms cube), asinh (softening 0.1) between the 5th and 99.8th percentile (0.4 to 27.6 K km/s); drawn as cyan with opacity from the stretch.

bar.label: W(CO)
bar.note: 3 sigma clipped moment 0; asinh colour scale

lmc-snr.title: Polarized signal to noise
lmc-snr.stretch: Linear grey from 0 to 20; the red line marks S/N = 3.
lmc-snr.smoothing: Same smoothing as the field texture (8′ sigma). S/N above 3 over 87% of the grid and 98% within 4° of the centre.

fits.what: Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

dotfield.title: Field dashes
dotfield.stretch: Field angle on a 96 by 96 block grid (circular mean of 2θ); dashes fade out where the polarized S/N is below 3.
dotfield.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with an 8′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 20′. Milky Way foreground not removed.

fits.what: Field position angle, east of north (deg)
Polarized S/N at the field smoothing

region-orion.title: Planck dust with the field texture
region-orion.stretch: Dust: log intensity stretched between the 1st and 99.8th percentile, copper palette; the texture is added to the value (amount 0.4).
region-orion.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 22′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 53′ with the beam.

region-monoceros_ob1.stretch: Dust: log intensity stretched between the 1st and 99.8th percentile, copper palette; the texture is added to the value (amount 0.4).
region-monoceros_ob1.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 5′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 14′ with the beam.

region-galactic_centre.stretch: Dust: log intensity stretched between the 1st and 99.8th percentile, copper palette; the texture is added to the value (amount 0.4).
region-galactic_centre.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 9′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 22′ with the beam.

region-taurus.title: Planck dust with the field texture
region-taurus.stretch: Dust: log intensity stretched between the 1st and 99.8th percentile, copper palette; the texture is added to the value (amount 0.4).
region-taurus.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 20′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 47′ with the beam.

region-mbm12.title: Planck dust with the field texture
region-mbm12.stretch: Dust: log intensity stretched between the 1st and 99.8th percentile, copper palette; the texture is added to the value (amount 0.4).
region-mbm12.smoothing: Q and U smoothed with a 5′ sigma Gaussian, FWHM 14′ with the beam.
